verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs describe an open-source framework for computer-control agents, so some of the vendor's source is presented as openly readable. There is no evidence that the main Sai product (cloud agent, API, desktop app) is open-source. No license or repository is named, and the clonable community scripts are adjacent material that earns no credit. Missing for 10: named open license, link to a public source repository, evidence that Sai's core code is open, independent confirmation the framework source is readable.
